title: Flood dated up to 40,000 years ago from ice cores
place_text: Mesopotamia / Greenland and Antarctic ice cores

tellings.quote: could be up to 40,000 years ago based on looking at ice course sampling and previous climatic events of when floods could have occurred

plain: The great flood of ancient Mesopotamian stories could have happened as long as 40,000 years ago, according to a researcher named Matt LaCroix, who tells it without naming a source. He bases this on ice cores, long columns of ice drilled from Greenland and Antarctica that keep a record of past climate, and on earlier climate events that could have caused floods. If true, the flood memory would reach back far beyond the usual timeline of human civilisation.
